title: Autumn Fox

steps.heading: Get ready
paragraphs: Cover your table. Start with the preprinted fox canvas. Keep the background white.
Use thin coats. Rinse your brush and pat it dry when you change colors.
steps.remainWhite: All paint regions and the background

steps.heading: Paint the orange fur
paragraphs: Use orange for the head, outer ears, body and lower tail.
Leave the face patches, chest, tail tip, scarf, paws and leaves white. Let it dry.
steps.newPaint: Orange head, outer ears, body and lower tail
steps.remainWhite: Face patches, inner ears, chest, tail tip, scarf, paws, leaves and background

steps.heading: Add the ivory fur
paragraphs: Use ivory for the face patches, inner ears, chest and tail tip.
Keep the scarf, paws and leaves white. Let the paint dry.
steps.newPaint: Ivory face patches, inner ears, chest and tail tip

steps.heading: Paint the scarf
paragraphs: Paint every other scarf stripe forest green.
Paint the open stripes golden yellow. Keep the black dividing lines easy to see.
steps.newPaint: Forest green and golden yellow scarf stripes

steps.heading: Paint the leaves
paragraphs: Paint the maple leaf orange. Paint the oak leaf golden yellow.
Use your small brush near the edges. Let the leaves dry.
steps.newPaint: Orange maple leaf and golden yellow oak leaf

steps.heading: Finish the little details
paragraphs: Use black for the paws and ear tips.
Use black for the eyes, nose, smile and leaf stems too. Keep or add a tiny white dot in each eye.
steps.newPaint: Black paws, ear tips, face details and leaf stems; white eye dots

care: Use thin coats. Rinse your brush and pat it dry when you change colors. Let each color dry before painting beside it.
cleanup: Lay your canvas flat to dry. Wash your brushes and close the paint pots.
sourceNotes: Retained source stages 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 and 7. Stage 5 combines the two scarf-color actions into one child-friendly step. In the final target, the existing native paws group mask changes only the dark-brown paws and ear tips to black. Every pixel outside that mask remains identical to original stage 7. Texture, shading and highlight stages 8-11 are omitted. Existing heavier teaching linework is retained in the pictures; the production transfer remains the unchanged gray SVG.
